name: Possessions-versus-results total
hypothesis: The efficiency page sees pace and efficiency shifts before the results log absorbs them, so a gap between the two totals is the signal, not noise.
signal: E2_total - E1_total (possessions x PPP minus the results-log total)
universe: every game in the rolling window with both estimators available
rule: over when E2_total - E1_total >= +4.0; under when <= -4.0; otherwise no bet
refusals: no bet if either club's luck z-score is outside +-1.96 (noise band)
no bet if the official injury report has not been filed for that game date
settlement: over wins when (home_pts + away_pts) > blend_total, under wins when it is lower; an exact hit settles as a loss. Settled from the official final score.
status: frozen — not eligible for publication until it clears its gates
